comparison.objective: Swap an orbital replacement unit between keyed bays, versus adjust an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Extraction, 90-degree reorientation, stowage, and spare insertion, not setscrew/collar servicing.
comparison.success_condition: Red unit stowed rotated 90 degrees and grey spare seated; seating, collision, connector, and damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests remove-reorient-insert logistics for rigid modules, not calibration from dynamic response.
